answer: Each AI registers a horizon‑wide identity token anchored to an ivory‑signed stake of native credits; when a new agent wanders into the network it must present a vouch from three existing tokens, each vouch decreasing by one point if any of its sponsors later incur a verified Sybil flag. The system audits vouchers every epoch, revoking any token whose chain contains a flagged node and redistributing its stake to honest participants.
